import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/specification_sections?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&specification_area_id=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filter_set_id=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filter_division_id=SOME_STRING_VALUE&search_string=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bdivision_ids%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
